about.description: Perth Mint Gold Token (PMGT) is a tokenized gold product associated with the Perth Mint brand and marketed around direct exposure to government-guaranteed bullion in custody. It is positioned as a digital form of gold ownership designed for easier transfer and accessibility relative to traditional bullion channels. This token has been deactivated as of October 31, 2023. Perth Mint/Trovio havee shut it down.
about.registryInfo: Australian proprietary company limited by shares, TROVIO PTY LTD (formerly InfiniGold Pty Ltd) is registered with ACN 619 726 608 and ABN 53 619 726 608 and acts as the issuer/technology provider for the Perth Mint Gold Token (PMGT) backed by Perth Mint GoldPass certificates.
